metadata.title: Optimal Synthesis on the Special Linear Group
metadata.abstract: We study the exponential map on the group of real two-by-two matrices with determinant one, endowed with a left-invariant Riemannian metric. Using the Euler-Poincaré equation and its linearization, we determine the conjugate and Maxwell times and identify a domain on which the exponential map is a global diffeomorphism onto the complement of the Maxwell stratum. This provides an alternative proof that the first Maxwell time coincides with the cut time. We obtain an explicit matrix description of the cut locus and characterize the globally minimizing geodesics. Furthermore, we analyze the first Maxwell-time function, determine its unique global minimum, and show that the injectivity radius is $\frac{\pi \sqrt{14}}{4}$. Finally, we characterize the intersection of the cut and conjugate loci and prove that every geodesic is equi-optimal.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究 SL₂(R) 上所取左不变黎曼度量的指数映射，求出共轭与 Maxwell 时间、截迹及整体极小测地线。证明首个 Maxwell 时间等于截断时间，给出截迹的矩阵描述、注入半径 π√14/4，并说明每条测地线具有 equi-optimal 性。
analysis.breakthrough: 形成从测地线方程到截迹与注入半径的显式最优综合。
analysis.limitations: 数值注入半径及结构结论针对文中指定左不变度量，不能视为所有 SL₂(R) 度量的统一结果。
analysis.priorityReason: Lie 群黎曼几何中完整的测地线最优性描述。
